unresolved.reason: Exact-taxon candidates are too murky for a hero image; retain the clearer original pending attribution verification.
Candidates show a distant animal or carcasses; retain the clear original living animal pending attribution verification.
Candidates show a chrysalis or distant cluster; retain the clear original adult pending attribution verification.
Candidates are a fish close-up and dead moose; retain the clear original living moose pending attribution verification.
Candidates show a distant aerial interaction; retain the clear original Eurasian Goshawk pending attribution verification.
Candidates are distant or handling scenes; retain the clearer original pending attribution verification.
Candidates obscure most of the animal in water; retain the clearer original pending attribution verification.
The only candidate is less diagnostic than the published animal; retain the original pending attribution verification.
Candidates are obscured by a sign or resemble admixed free-ranging chickens; retain the diagnostic original pending attribution verification.
Candidates are a carcass or distant running animal; retain the clearer original pending attribution verification.
All candidates show a very distant animal; retain the clear original pending attribution verification.
Candidates are a constrained animal, market remains, or an unclear doorway scene; retain the clear original pending attribution verification.
All candidates show skulls rather than a living animal; retain the clear original pending attribution verification.
All candidates are distant or partly obscured; retain the clear original portrait pending attribution verification.
Candidates are washed out or less diagnostic than the original; retain the clear original pending attribution verification.
The only candidate is a distribution map, not an animal; retain the clear original bird pending attribution verification.
Candidates show neonates or distant animals; retain the clear original pending attribution verification.
Candidates are distant groups; retain the clear original individual pending attribution verification.
All candidates show animals too distant for reliable hero-image identification; retain the clear original pending attribution verification.
All candidates are unrelated birds; retain the correct original thorn bug pending attribution verification.
All candidates are very distant; retain the clearer original pending attribution verification.
Candidates are blank/underexposed or a toy; retain the clear original pending attribution verification.
Candidates are line drawings; retain the clearer original specimen image pending attribution verification.
